about: Max's art feedback, read by tools/art_finder.py on every run. 'hint' and 'pages' steer the wiki search, 'prefer' words raise a file's name score, 'avoid' words skip a file before download. Add notes with: python tools/art_finder.py note <item> "what Max said" --prefer word --avoid word --hint "scene" --page "Wiki page".

lessons: Show the named technique or item actually being used, not a portrait of the character standing around (Max 2026-11-27: Thunderbolt Tempo, Pop Green, Gojo teleport, Flower Breathing, Reelseiden).
Subject centered and fully in frame: not an extreme face close-up and not a tiny figure in a wide shot (Rengoku, Sakura, Satsuki, Shoto, Tenya).
One clear subject: busy two-tone backgrounds or dark frames where you cannot tell what is happening fail (Blade Set, Blood Transfusion, Final Shine).
Prefer the newest anime season's look when the character appears in it (Kenpachi: Thousand-Year Blood War).
Duos must show both characters together (Fukasaku & Shima).
Reject frames with TV-channel or site logos (MBS, TBS, anime1.com), title cards, opening/ending credits, posters with text, game screenshots and manga panels.
Check the wiki's file categories: 'Images of <character>' tells you who is really in the frame (Episode 23-2 was Akira Kuno, not Fuuko).

Equipment cards must show the object itself in frame (Gekota strap), and effect cards must show the effect happening (stand shattering, arm launched, telepathy). A portrait of the character is not enough. (Max 2026-11-27)
Galleries: leave out cards Max already approved and images he already turned down; show only cards still needing a pick (Max 2026-11-27).
